findings.claim: At both end Path B reads the TS wall gate ratio sits 1.2-1.7 points under the CPU-time ratio
On the TD-3 boxes node runs 1.040 CPUs per wall second and ep9 1.026; node/ep9 = 1.0136, the size of the F01 gap
The clock is not the confound: cycles per task-clock second are equal within 0.7% for ep9, node and QuickJS
ep9 spends 4.43% of its e-jitless TS cycles on GC on the JS thread (box 1 5.21%) = 1.11 G of 24.36 G main-thread cycles

With an estimated node main-thread GC of 1.3%, the ep9 main-thread GC excess over node is about 0.78 G = 3.2% of ep9 main-thread cycles (2.3-4.1%); ep9 is about 0.47 G ahead in non-GC main-thread work
The 92.83% node helper share of the summary is a thread-name error: node's JS thread is MainThread (88.02%); the helper share is V8Worker 4.82%
node --jitless keeps parallel scavenge, concurrent marking and sweeping and parallel compaction; only --single-threaded-gc turns them off
ep9 on 2 CPUs has 1 mark helper that works only inside the stop-the-world pause and 1 sweeper; the helpers take 2.84 points of JS-thread GC and save x1.022 of wall
TS GC count per run on x86: e-jitless 11 (box 1 12), e-jit 13, 0 helpers 10; 0.40% of cycles per GC on the main thread
To close the m11-end need by the off-loop part alone ep9 must remove 74-100% of its main-thread GC (1 - 1/g form); the m12-end need is jitless 41-47%, jit 88%
The TD-3 boxes read the TS cell near 1.0; the harness form moves ep9 and node alike

findings.claim: The read-to-read move on nearly the same VM code: TS cells x0.998 to x1.013; all 16 gate cells x0.998 to x1.049; 14 of 16 up on both boxes

The jitless box-1 cell 0.985 [0.978-1.001] needs x1.022 at its low end; the largest same-code TS move is 1.3 points, so a pass by less than about 1.3 points cannot be told from a read draw with 2 reads
The same-code move of the TS jitless cell supports R23 candidate O1 (the month-11 flat cell may be read-to-read noise)
The ranked off-loop list after TD-3: G8-0 items 1-3 give x1.008 at their centers in A/B terms, x1.010 with allocation cuts, x1.016 with S2b

Layer 1 is built: patch 0002 with 22 sites at oxc_parser 0.158.0 (20 checks + 2 loops), a per-thread limit sp_entry - (W - RED), 11 gated points of the depth walk, a visitor-graph proof test, T-HOLES 321 rows
The parse-only cost of layer 1 is +0.455% of instructions on Octane x20 (Mac arm64, release), under the +1.0% gate and under the design upper estimate 0.57%
The start fact of L1: a hole hunt of 297 classes found 103 that abort the process (71 valid JS) in 18 rule families

Review round 2 found one HIGH defect: an eval text with a long TS qualified-name chain aborted the process; the fix 8ed08541 added gates, and the proof test found 5 open cycle groups where the review found 2

The second-model review of the L1 code slice was stopped by its service filter (1 run, 18 read commands, no result; the third stop on parser-stack code that day); 2 Claude review lenses + a verifier took its place
Process: every code range needs a review round before the merge; a draft's commands run again at the tag; a registered row is never re-worded after its data
